component.name: OpenScreen
component.summary: Screen recorder and editor for product demos

description.p: This is a community package of OpenScreen. It installs the official Linux AppImage, unpacked without changes, and follows stable upstream releases.
Record a screen or window, then turn the take into a polished product demo with zooms, cursor effects, captions, annotations, backgrounds, and MP4 or GIF export.

Screen recording uses your desktop's ScreenCast portal, which asks what to share. Recordings and projects are kept in OpenScreen's private app data; opening and saving files elsewhere uses the file chooser. Network access is used for on-device model downloads and AI providers you configure. AI provider keys are stored through your desktop's Secret Service.

On Wayland, mouse-click telemetry and click effects need read access to mouse event devices. Recording works without this optional access. To enable it, grant device access with flatpak override --user --device=all com.etiennelescot.openscreen. Undo the override with flatpak override --user --reset com.etiennelescot.openscreen.
